events.title: ⚒️ THE DEMO IS OUT!
events.summary: Hey, Blacksmiths!The wait is over! The demo is now live on Steam. Jump in right now, take over an abandoned workshop and bring its cold forge back to life. It covers the game's opening chapter, where you become the town's new blacksmith, solo or with friends in co-op.Quick reminder of what's waiting for you: mine ore and chop wood, craft swords, shields, bows and necklaces in hands-on minigames, hire a forge assistant and a bard, open your own shop and grow from rookie to Level 4 along the way.

events.title: 🔨 PLAYTEST CLOSED
events.summary: Good day, everyone!The forge fires are cooling down for now, as the playtest has officially ended. Thank you to every blacksmith who picked up a hammer and joined our game.Together, over 40,000 blacksmiths joined the playtests, including our Closed playtest.We gathered a ton of valuable feedback thanks to everyone who actively filled out the survey and shared their thoughts. Our team is already working on improvements and fixes based on your input. We'll keep you posted here and on Discord. Unti

events.title: Ready to forge? Join the open playtest!
events.summary: Blacksmiths, assemble! Every kingdom needs steel, and this one has just run out of it. Bring the old forge back to life - join the open playtest and become a blacksmith right now!Here, you'll get to restore an old workshop from scratch, forge legendary swords, enchant armor, and much more. And the best part is, you can do all of this either on your own or in co-op with friends!
